plain: You still owe us $2,340 for invoice 1187.
legal: The sum of $2,340 remains outstanding in respect of invoice number 1187.

plain: Please pay within 7 days or we'll take further action.
legal: Payment is required within seven (7) days of the date of this notice, failing which further action shall be taken without further notice.

plain: This is your final reminder.
legal: This constitutes final notice.

plain: We're writing to tell you the lease will not be renewed.
legal: The Landlord hereby gives notice that the Lease shall not be renewed.

plain: You need to move out by September 30.
legal: The Tenant is required to vacate the Premises on or before September 30.

plain: Stop using our trademark on your website immediately.
legal: The Recipient is hereby required to cease all use of the trademark on its website with immediate effect.

plain: Confirm in writing within 10 days that you've stopped.
legal: The Recipient shall confirm in writing within ten (10) days of the date hereof that such use has ceased.

plain: We are ending the contract because the work hasn't been delivered.
legal: The Company hereby terminates the Agreement on the ground that the work has not been delivered.

plain: We accept your resignation, and your last day will be November 14.
legal: The Company accepts the Employee's resignation, and the Employee's final day of employment shall be November 14.

plain: The meeting of shareholders will be held on June 12 at 10 am.
legal: Notice is hereby given that the meeting of shareholders shall be held on June 12 at 10 am.

plain: You can vote by proxy if you can't attend.
legal: Any shareholder who is unable to attend may vote by proxy.

plain: Proxy forms must be received at least 48 hours before the meeting.
legal: Proxy forms shall be received not less than forty-eight (48) hours before the time appointed for the meeting.

plain: The water will be shut off on Monday from 9 am to 1 pm for repairs.
legal: The water supply shall be suspended on Monday from 9 am to 1 pm for the purpose of carrying out repairs.

plain: We're raising the rent by $75 starting March 1.
legal: The Tenant is hereby notified that the rent shall increase by $75 with effect from March 1.

plain: We've received your complaint and will reply within 10 working days.
legal: The Company acknowledges receipt of the complaint and shall respond within ten (10) working days.

plain: Your claim has been rejected because it was filed too late.
legal: The claim has been rejected on the ground that it was not submitted within the prescribed period.

plain: You can appeal this decision within 21 days.
legal: An appeal against this decision may be lodged within twenty-one (21) days.

plain: We're changing our address to 44 Harbour Road from April 1.
legal: With effect from April 1, the Company's registered address shall be 44 Harbour Road.

plain: Your account is overdue and has been suspended.
legal: The Customer's account is in arrears and has accordingly been suspended.

plain: Service will be restored once the balance is paid.
legal: The Service shall be restored upon payment of the outstanding balance.

plain: We dispute the charges on your invoice dated May 2.
legal: The Company disputes the charges set out in the invoice dated May 2.

plain: We won't pay the disputed amount until we get supporting documents.
legal: The disputed amount shall not be paid until the supporting documentation has been provided.

plain: Please treat this letter as formal notice under clause 14 of our agreement.
legal: This letter shall constitute formal notice pursuant to clause 14 of the Agreement.

plain: The car you sold me has a defect that you didn't tell me about.
legal: The Vehicle sold to the Buyer has a defect that the Seller failed to disclose.

plain: I want a full refund of $6,400.
legal: The Buyer hereby demands a full refund of the purchase price of $6,400.

plain: If you don't respond within 14 days, I'll take the matter further.
legal: Should no response be received within fourteen (14) days, the Buyer shall pursue the matter further.

plain: We confirm that the debt has been paid in full.
legal: The Creditor hereby confirms that the debt has been discharged in full.

plain: Nothing more is owed by either party.
legal: No further sums are owed by either Party.

plain: Your probation has been extended by one month.
legal: The Employee's probationary period has been extended by one (1) month.

plain: You were absent without notice on 3 days in October.
legal: The Employee was absent without notice on three (3) days during October.

plain: This letter is a formal warning.
legal: This letter constitutes a formal written warning.

plain: Another absence without notice may lead to dismissal.
legal: Any further unauthorized absence may result in dismissal.

plain: The road will be closed for the parade on Saturday.
legal: The road shall be closed to traffic on Saturday for the duration of the parade.

plain: Vehicles parked on the street will be towed.
legal: Vehicles parked on the street shall be removed at the owner's expense.

plain: The pool is closed for maintenance until further notice.
legal: The swimming pool shall remain closed for maintenance until further notice.

plain: We're recalling the heater because it may overheat.
legal: The Heater is subject to a product recall owing to a risk of overheating.

plain: Stop using it and return it to any store for a full refund.
legal: Customers shall cease using the Heater and may return it to any store for a full refund.

plain: We have changed our terms; the new terms apply from July 1.
legal: The Company has amended its terms and conditions, and the amended terms shall apply with effect from July 1.

plain: Your request to work part-time has been approved.
legal: The Employee's request to work on a part-time basis has been approved.

plain: Your new hours will be 24 per week.
legal: The Employee's working hours shall be twenty-four (24) per week.

plain: Your membership will be renewed on January 5 unless you cancel.
legal: The membership shall be renewed on January 5 unless cancelled by the Member.

plain: We received your payment of $910, thank you.
legal: The Company acknowledges receipt of payment in the amount of $910.

plain: The balance of $90 is still due.
legal: The balance of $90 remains due and payable.

plain: The election results will be announced on Friday.
legal: The results of the election shall be announced on Friday.

plain: Any objections must be made in writing by Thursday.
legal: Any objection shall be submitted in writing no later than Thursday.

plain: Please keep this letter for your records.
legal: The recipient is advised to retain this letter for record purposes.

plain: The building will be inspected on August 8.
legal: An inspection of the Building shall be carried out on August 8.

plain: Please make sure we can get into your unit that day.
legal: Each occupant shall ensure that access to the occupant's unit is available on the date of inspection.

plain: We regret to tell you that your application was not successful.
legal: The applicant is hereby informed that the application has been unsuccessful.

plain: You can reapply after 6 months.
legal: The applicant may submit a new application after a period of six (6) months.
